info.title: EmailListVerify Universal API
info.description: EmailListVerify validates email deliverability, checks disposable domains and blacklists, finds business contacts, manages bulk verification jobs, checks inbox placement tests, and reports account credits through its documented REST API.

get.description: Checks IP or domain blacklists in EmailListVerify.

parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: IP address or domain to check against DNS-based blacklists.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
